problem_title: How to turn boxcarring OFF for LWC imperative apex method calls?
problem: We are running in a blocking performance issue on a page that we built using Lightning Web Components. Our page has many LWC components, each calling various apex methods via an imperative method call. The apex methods in turn make callouts to a third-party API. We found that the page had terrible performance taking 30+ seconds to load even though each of the third-party API calls would only take 1-2 seconds each....
